tree: How can a business manage all appointments in one calendar?
Appointment scheduling calendar software shows every booking for every staff member in one view, so you can spot gaps, avoid double bookings and move appointments in seconds.
Separate calendars and paper books lead to double bookings and missed appointments.
One shared calendar shows every appointment, staff member and free slot.
Switch views to see your schedule the way you need it.
See real-time availability across your team, get instant conflict alerts, and manage buffer times between appointments.
First-time consultation. Discuss wellness goals and create a personalized plan.
Quickly reschedule appointments, manage waitlists, and keep your customers informed automatically.
Powerful tools to manage appointments for your team and deliver a better experience to your customers.
Flexible scheduling for any service-based business, from individual professionals to multi-location teams.
